channel.title: EIA: What's New
channel.description: What's New at the Energy Information Administration

item.title: Quarterly Coal Report—Second Quarter 2026
item.description: (Thu, 01 Oct 2026) U.S. coal production during the second quarter of 2026 totaled 125.4 million short tons (MMst), which was 4.9% lower than the previous quarter and 2.2% lower than the second quarter of 2025. Second-quarter 2026 U.S. coal exports (26.8 MMst) increased 13.3% from the first-quarter 2026 level and increased 19.2% from the second-quarter 2025 level. U.S. coal imports in the second quarter of 2026 totaled 0.7 MMst. All data for 2024 and previous years are final. All data for 2025 and 2026 are preliminary.

item.title: Wholesale Electricity Market Data
item.description: (Thu, 01 Oct 2026) This report includes spreadsheets with wholesale electricity and natural gas data from seven major trading hubs that cover most regions of the United States. The data are through September 29, 2026, and republished, with permission, from the Intercontinental Exchange (ICE).

item.title: Petroleum Marketing Monthly
item.description: (Thu, 01 Oct 2026) The October 2026 <em>Petroleum Marketing Monthly</em>, with data through July 2026, presents monthly and annual price and volume statistics for crude oil sales in the United States.

item.title: Quarterly Coal Distribution Report—Second Quarter 2026
item.description: (Thu, 01 Oct 2026) The <em>Quarterly Coal Distribution Report</em> (QCDR) provides detailed U.S. domestic coal distribution data (excluding waste coal and imports) for second-quarter 2026 by coal-origin state, coal-destination state, mode of transportation, and consuming sector. Quarterly coal distribution data for all quarters are preliminary and will be updated in the corresponding <em>Annual Coal Distribution Report</em>.

item.title: Natural Gas Monthly
item.description: (Wed, 30 Sep 2026) The <em>Natural Gas Monthly</em> presents volume and price data each month for natural gas production, distribution, consumption, and interstate pipeline activities. NGM also reports producer-related activities and underground storage data. NGM data on 50 U.S. states and the District of Columbia are collected on EIA surveys.

item.title: Petroleum Supply Monthly
item.description: (Wed, 30 Sep 2026) The report includes supply and disposition of crude oil and petroleum products on the national and regional levels. The data series describe production, imports and exports, movements, and inventories.

item.title: Company Level Imports
item.description: (Wed, 30 Sep 2026) These data include company-level imports data collected from the Form EIA-814, <em>Monthly Imports Report</em>.

item.title: Monthly Energy Review
item.description: (Tue, 29 Sep 2026) The <em>Monthly Energy Review</em> is our comprehensive report on recent and historical energy statistics. According to our September 2026 report, preliminary estimates indicate that U.S. total primary energy production equaled 54 quadrillion British thermal units (quads) in the first six months of 2026, a 3% increase from the same period in 2025. U.S. total primary energy consumption equaled 48 quads in the first six months of 2026, a 1% decrease from the same period in 2025.

item.title: U.S. Biofuels Plant Production Capacity Report
item.description: (Thu, 24 Sep 2026) The <em>U.S. Biofuels Plant Production Capacity Report</em> with data for all operating U.S. fuel ethanol, biodiesel, and renewable diesel fuel and other biofuels production plants as of January 1, 2026. Starting September 2026, this report consolidates the three individual reports on U.S. biodiesel, fuel ethanol, and renewable diesel fuel and other biofuels plant production capacity.

item.title: Electric Power Monthly
item.description: (Thu, 24 Sep 2026) Data in the September 2026 <em>Electric Power Monthly</em> are for July 2026, when net generation in the United States increased 1.7% from July 2025. Coal consumption for power generation was down 6.0% compared with the previous year. The average residential retail price of electricity was up 4.9% from July 2025.
